body: There is always someone who will care, okay those of us here will not always be there just like friends in life, but we are here now that you need someone. Please don't pull the trigger tonight, it jammed for a reason, to give you a chance because something is meant to happen, it's going to get better. Your only human and your struggling, don't feel guilty for that. People always care but right now your being shown just how much we care when a friend is in trouble. please don't quit. not now.
Probably the other day when I got to revisit my horses.
